name: Serper Google Search
description: Direct REST API connector for Google search results through Serper. Returns structured organic results and SERP metadata. Requires a Serper API key and usage credits according to the provider's plan.

credentialFields.label: Serper API key
credentialFields.help: Create an API key in your Serper account. Keep it private.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search Google through Serper and return structured organic results, snippets and search metadata.

query.description: Search terms or a natural-language question.

permissions.description: Sends the search query and configured search options to the provider over HTTPS.
Reads the search result titles, snippets, URLs and metadata returned by the provider.
